unani.note: Chukandar leans garam; given for blood-building.

guna.note: Fresh and simple — the sattvic default for plant food eaten close to how it grew.

effects.note: Beetroot's dietary nitrate converts in the body to nitric oxide, a natural blood-vessel relaxant, and meta-analyses of RCTs — mostly run on beetroot juice — find a real drop in systolic blood pressure. A couple of cooked beets approaches the nitrate dose those trials use, though whole-root nitrate content swings a good deal with soil and variety, less predictable than a measured juice shot. A possible effect, not a promise — response to it varies from person to person.
